latest.title: Dispatcher CPR and survival in shockable OHCA
latest.finding: DA-CPR ongoing at arrival vs crew-initiated: ROSC 92.0% vs 12.4%, hospital admission with sustained circulation 90.8% vs 11.7%, 30-day survival 54.6% vs 7.1%, one-year survival 45.8% vs 6.2% (all P < 0.001)

latest.title: EMS sepsis suspicion speeds up ED antibiotics
latest.finding: EMS-suspected sepsis: 63.3% antibiotics within 1 h of ED arrival vs 19.2% (aOR 5.77, 95% CI 2.14–16.4); median time to antibiotics 32.0 vs 124.5 min

latest.title: Cardiogenic shock: prehospital recognition and routing
latest.finding: Emphasises early prehospital/ED identification and immediate transfer to a cardiogenic shock centre; no new outcome data
